sources.entry: Clawd on Desk by Ruller_Lulu - A desktop pet that reacts to your Claude Code sessions in real-time — thinking, typing, juggling, sleeping, and more. Yep. It's undeniably endearing. And at the end of the day, isn't that what Claude Code is all about?

summary.one_liner: Clawd on Desk is a pixel desktop pet that reacts in real time to AI coding agents such as Claude Code and Codex, showing their status through animated states.
summary.what_it_does: The app shows an animated pixel crab (and other themes) that changes state based on agent hooks and logs: thinking while you prompt, typing while tools run, juggling when subagents pile up, and dozing when you step away. It can show a permission bubble so you can Allow or Deny tool requests from a floating card or a global hotkey, or switch to auto-approve. A HUD next to the pet and a dashboard list live sessions, with one-click jump to their terminal, quota rings, and a private local recap. Remote approval is offered through Telegram, Feishu/Lark, and Slack notifications, plus a read-only mobile PWA. Claude Code and Codex are connected on first launch; many other agents can be added from Settings, and a custom HTTP endpoint covers other tools.
use_cases: Monitor Claude Code sessions while working elsewhere
Approve or deny agent tool requests from a popup or hotkey
Get phone or chat notifications when a long agent task finishes
Track multiple coding agent sessions side by side
Create a custom animated desktop theme for an agent
how_to_run: Download the installer from GitHub Releases (Windows, macOS .dmg or brew cask, or Linux AppImage/.deb)
Launch Clawd; Claude Code and Codex are connected on first launch
For source builds: git clone the repository and cd clawd-on-desk
notable: Animated states driven by agent hooks and logs, with eye tracking, sleep sequence, and click reactions
Permission bubbles with Allow/Deny via floating card, global hotkey, or auto-approve
Works with 20+ agent CLIs including Claude Code, Codex, Copilot, Gemini, Cursor, and opencode
Theme system with built-in Clawd, Calico, and Cloudling plus downloadable official themes and a theme creation command
Runs on Windows (x64 and ARM64), macOS, and Linux, with Remote SSH and WSL support
caveats: Source builds download Electron and build tooling, so node_modules gets large
Some agents lack permission bubbles; per-agent gaps are listed in the known limitations guide
Clawd character is Anthropic's property and the project is an unofficial fan project; artwork and theme assets are not covered by the AGPL-3.0 license
